generated_programs:
# Go to bathroom and locate the cabinet and hygiene items
find('bathroom')
walk('bathroom')
find('bathroomcabinet')
open('bathroomcabinet')
find('barsoap')
grab('barsoap')
putin('barsoap','bathroomcabinet')
find('toothbrush')

grab('toothbrush')
close('bathroomcabinet')
# Deliver toothbrush to the bed
find('bedroom')
walk('bedroom')
find('bed')
putback('toothbrush','bed')
